text.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ لَآ أُقْسِمُ بِهَٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ

translations.asad: NAY! I call to witness this land –
translations.sahih: I swear by this city, Makkah -

translations.asad: this land in which thou art free to dwell -
translations.sahih: And you, [O Muhammad], are free of restriction in this city -

translations.asad: and [I call to witness] parent and offspring:
translations.sahih: And [by] the father and that which was born [of him],

translations.asad: Verily, We have created man into [a life of] pain, toil and trial.
translations.sahih: We have certainly created man into hardship.

text.arabic: أَيَحْسَبُ أَن لَّن يَقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ أَحَدٌۭ

translations.asad: Does he, then, think that no one has power over him?
translations.sahih: Does he think that never will anyone overcome him?

translations.asad: He boasts, "I have spent wealth abundant!"
translations.sahih: He says, "I have spent wealth in abundance."

translations.asad: Does he, then, think that no one sees him?
translations.sahih: Does he think that no one has seen him?

translations.asad: Have We not given him two eyes,
translations.sahih: Have We not made for him two eyes?

translations.asad: and a tongue, and a pair of lips,
translations.sahih: And a tongue and two lips?

translations.asad: and shown him the two highways [of good and evil]?
translations.sahih: And have shown him the two ways?

translations.asad: But he would not try to ascend the steep uphill road...
translations.sahih: But he has not broken through the difficult pass.

translations.asad: And what could make thee conceive what it is, that steep uphill road?
translations.sahih: And what can make you know what is [breaking through] the difficult pass?

translations.asad: [It is] the freeing of one's neck [from the burden of sin],
translations.sahih: It is the freeing of a slave

text.arabic: أَوْ إِطْعَٰمٌۭ فِى يَوْمٍۢ ذِى مَسْغَبَةٍۢ

translations.asad: or the feeding, upon a day of [one's own] hunger,
translations.sahih: Or feeding on a day of severe hunger

translations.asad: of an orphan near of kin,
translations.sahih: An orphan of near relationship

translations.asad: or of a needy [stranger] lying in the dust –
translations.sahih: Or a needy person in misery

text.arabic: ثُمَّ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْمَرْحَمَةِ

translations.asad: and being, withal, of those who have attained to faith, and who enjoin upon one another patience in adversity, and enjoin upon one another compassion.
translations.sahih: And then being among those who believed and advised one another to patience and advised one another to compassion.

translations.asad: Such are they that have attained to righteousness;
translations.sahih: Those are the companions of the right.

text.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا هُمْ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ

translations.asad: whereas those who are bent on denying the truth of Our messages – they are such as have lost themselves in evil,
translations.sahih: But they who disbelieved in Our signs - those are the companions of the left.

translations.asad: [with] fire closing in upon them.
translations.sahih: Over them will be fire closed in.
